decision_conditions: Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed any wall of the building hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The detached outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for purposes ancillary to the enjoyment of the dwellinghouse known as No. 193 Great West Road and for no other purpose (e.g. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, seperate dwelling or for business use or office)
description: Erection of a single storey detached outbuilding to rear of dwellinghouse.
